description: Public profile page at /profile/[id]. Shows avatar (initial on gradient circle), name, join date, stats grid (projects/followers/following/rating), follow button (for non-self visitors), and their listed projects in a card grid.

elements.label: Profile avatar
elements.purpose: Gradient circle (teal→cyan) with user's first initial centered in white bold text. Large size (80-96px).

elements.label: Follow button
elements.purpose: Conditional: hidden for self-profile view. Toggle between 'Following' (outline) and 'Follow' (filled teal). Calls toggleFollowAction server action.

elements.label: Stats row
elements.purpose: 4-column divided grid: Projects (listings count), Followers (follows.count), Following (reverse follows count), Rating (avg review stars)
elements.schema_column_mapping: COUNT(listings WHERE status='approved'), COUNT(follows.following_id=follower_id), COUNT(follows.follower_id=user_id), AVG(reviews.rating)

elements.label: User's project grid
elements.purpose: ListingCardGrid showing all approved listings by this seller, sorted newest-first

elements.label: No listings message
elements.purpose: 'No projects listed yet' shown when user has zero approved listings
